chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from al-Husayn ibn Saif, from Uthman, from Salih ibn Abi al-Aswad, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) mentioned the Mosque of al-Sahlah and said, 'Indeed, it is the residence of our Master when he rises with his family.'

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.صَاحِبِنَا: Our Master, a title often referring to the Imam or the Mahdi
key_terms.مَسْجِدَ السَّهْلَةِ: The Mosque of al-Sahlah, a specific mosque in Kufa/Qum associated with Shia Imams

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Mosque of al-Sahlah according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) designates the Mosque of al-Sahlah as the specific residence (*manzil*) of the Imam when he is present with his family, highlighting its unique status as a private sanctuary for the Ahl al-Bayt. This identification underscores the historical significance of al-Sahlah in Kufa as a center of Imamate authority and scholarly gathering, distinguishing it from general congregational mosques by its intimate association with the Imam's household.
